'''U2-C1''' was a [[U2-C1-series housekeeping droid]] manufactured by [[Publictechnic]] and employed at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. The blue-colored droid informed the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]] about a threat to him.<ref name="CSWE" />
